questions.stem: Choose the most appropriate one-word substitution for the phrase: 'A person who does not believe in the existence of God'
questions.explanation:
WHY IT IS CORRECT: An 'Atheist' (a- = without, theos = god) is someone who firmly denies or disbelieves the existence of God or gods.
DECOY BUSTING: An 'Agnostic' believes that nothing is known or can be known regarding the existence of God (they are unsure, not in outright denial). A 'Theist' believes in God. A 'Philanthropist' is someone who loves mankind and donates to charity.
EXAM INSIGHT: 'Monotheist' believes in ONE god (Islam, Christianity). 'Polytheist' believes in MULTIPLE gods (Hinduism). 'Pantheist' believes the universe itself is God.
